engine_size_note: conn_sparse is behind #[cfg(feature = "conn-sparse")] and the feature is NOT in vmlm-core's default set, so the default inference engine does not link it; the measured default size is unchanged.
honest_limits: This is the STORAGE half of P1 only. It computes no forward pass and defines no opcode; connection-sparse ACTIVATION is another task.
k0>0 requires EXACTLY k0 connections per neuron, so the format cannot express a pruned-away ('dead') neuron. That is a known restriction of this version, not an oversight.
The initial weights are a deterministic, bit-exact placeholder distribution in [0.5, 1.0) (all positive). They carry no statistical meaning and are NOT trained weights.
src ids are drawn with % n_neurons and may repeat; 'k0 distinct sources' is NOT guaranteed or checked. Duplicate srcs mean parallel connections.
SEC_CONN_SPARSE is a reserved tag used only in examples/p16_conn; no production .vmb carries this section yet.
